author: k. e. diggs
title: Cherry Hill vote by mail drop box relocated to public library - Garden State Times
text:
The Camden County Board of Elections has announced the relocation of a vote by mail ballot drop box in Cherry Hill. The drop box, previously at the Cherry Hill Municipal Building, is now situated at the Cherry Hill Public Library at 1100 Kings Highway North. Another drop box remains available at the Camden County College William G. Rohrer Center on 1889 Marlton Pike East.
As vote by mail ballots begin arriving in residents’ mailboxes this weekend, county officials are emphasizing the importance of knowing all available drop box locations.
Since 2021, Camden County has maintained 29 secure and video-monitored drop boxes for vote by mail ballots across its municipalities. These boxes serve as an alternative to mailing ballots through the U.S. Postal Service and are managed by the Board of Elections.
“VBM drop boxes are conveniently located throughout Camden County to make voting easier and more convenient,” said Commissioner Louis Cappelli Jr. “Voters can rest assured that these boxes are safe and secure, and that their vote will be counted as long as their ballot is completed properly and placed in any VBM drop box prior to the closing of polls on November 4. Voters can also return their ballot by mail or by bringing it to the Board of Elections in person.”
Residents may use any of the 29 designated drop boxes within Camden County or deliver their ballots directly to the County Board of Elections office at 100 University Court in Gloucester Township.
A full list of ballot drop-off locations is available for voters across various municipalities including Audubon, Barrington, Bellmawr, Berlin Borough, Berlin Township, several sites in Camden City, Clementon, Collingswood, Gloucester City, Gloucester Township (including both municipal building and college campus), Haddon Township, Haddonfield, Haddon Heights, Lindenwold, Pennsauken, Pine Hill, Runnemede, Somerdale, Stratford (Rowan Medical Building), Voorhees Town Center, Waterford Township and Winslow Township.
